column1: # Game profile of 13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim, Japanese release (Japanese only, eShop), base game 1.00 (v0), SDK 10.8.2: Vanillaware's engine as in the western release 01003FC01670C000, whose note explains the memory keys,
# but every code module is its own build (main, sdk and subsdk0 all differ from the western and Asian releases' SDK 11.4.3 builds)
# Generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py (dm/games/profile_guess.py) with the western profile's alloc_big_align and depth_mode, then played on the Mac
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# from the western 13 Sentinels profile: the engine cuts ring heaps out of a memory pool at 64 KB alignment, so allocations of 64 KB or more are 64 KB aligned (hle_os.c);
# without it the prologue crashes with a null write at main+0x309080 as it enters its first battle (see README.md)
# the NVN depth mode the game sets (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode near = 0): the pipeline archive made offline holds the main0_z vertex entries (dm/gfx/tools/pso_offline.py)
